## cancel_booking
1. Webhook: select Header Auth credentials, e.g. X-Calnode-Tool-Key.
2. Cancel in Calnode: select your Calnode Bearer credential. Use an admin/owner key to cancel bookings across specialists.
3. Check BASE_URL in Prepare cancellation. Publish/activate and use the Production URL.

POST body: `{"booking_id":"UUID returned by get_bookings"}`
Optional: timezone (default Asia/Qyzylorda).

This tool cancels the exact supplied booking ID. It does not search by name/phone or guess which appointment to cancel. A repeat request for an already cancelled booking returns success.

The existing Calnode admin API records the credential user as the cancellation author; a supplied reason does not override that. Calendar/email side effects run asynchronously in Calnode. No credentials are included in this file.
